name: IntegrateIT Assistance Button
notes: Turns 1-4 wired help/panic buttons into one latching, per-station assistance call for elderly-care, accessibility, pool-alarm, or staff-call use. A press latches an assistance alarm, records which station called, and can re-alert on an interval until a caregiver acknowledges and clears it. Per-wiring press polarity, optional re-alert nagging, MAC-locked IntegrateIT licensing.
